claims.support_quote: Isodense soft tissue mass in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, with ill-defined boundaries and uniform density. Mass size approximately 4.1 cm x 2.7 cm x 2.9 cm with abnormal radioactive distribution. Several small lymph nodes in left axillary region, some with mildly concentrated radioactivity. No bone, lung, liver, or brain metastasis.
